name: inspect-target-direction
author: Claude
description: The bundle's payoff composition: toRoot(@target) minus toRoot(@position) is the direction to the current combat target in the wearer's root space, normalized by distance(). The emissive tint encodes it around mid-gray: R = +x, G = +y (ahead), B = +z, so circling a hostile rolls the hue as the wearer turns; dark when there is no target.

target.note: The combat target's world position; [0, 0, 0] when there is none

toTarget.note: Root-space direction to the hostile; the shared conversion cancels the translation, and its magnitude equals the world distance

tint.note: Half-unit direction around mid-gray; distance() normalizes, @hasTarget blacks it out when idle

stack.note: The direction-encoded tint on the whole piece
